_meta.source: 일단 합격하고 오겠습니다 TSC 실전문제집 (제4~7부분 실전테스트 1~5회). 문제 p.92~156, 해설 p.176~192.
_meta.style_prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters.
_meta.note: 제4,5부분=텍스트만(그림X). 제6부분=상황그림1장. 제7부분=4컷 스토리(한 이미지에 2x2 4컷 만화). 답안 병음은 pypinyin으로 빌드 시 자동생성.

실전1회.q_zh: 你跟朋友约好了这个周末一起去公园儿骑自行车。但是天气预报说周末会下雨，请你跟朋友解释一下，并建议去别的地方玩儿。
실전1회.q_ko: 주말에 친구와 공원에서 자전거 타기로 약속했는데 비 예보가 있음. 친구에게 설명하고 다른 곳을 제안하세요.
실전1회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A worried young woman talking on the phone, a small inset speech bubble showing a friend, rainy weather mood.

실전1회.q_zh: 你要买新车，所以你打算卖掉旧车，请你给卖二手车的地方打电话，问一下价格。
실전1회.q_ko: 새 차를 사려고 헌 차를 팔려 함. 중고차 매장에 전화해 가격을 물어보세요.
실전1회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A man talking on the phone with a thought bubble showing a small red car.

실전1회.q_zh: 你们公司打算招一个新职员，你觉得你的朋友很合适，这时你怎么向你的上司推荐？
실전1회.q_ko: 회사가 신입을 뽑으려 하고 친구가 적합하다고 생각함. 상사에게 어떻게 추천하나요?
실전1회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A standing male employee talking to his seated boss at a desk, recommending someone, a small thought bubble of a person.

실전2회.q_zh: 下星期你要去北京出差，因为是第一次去北京，所以你不太了解那里的情况，请你给在北京的同事打电话问一下那里的情况。
실전2회.q_ko: 다음 주 베이징 첫 출장이라 상황을 잘 모름. 베이징 동료에게 전화해 물어보세요.
실전2회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A worried office worker sitting at a desk with a computer, talking on the phone.

실전2회.q_zh: 在办公室里，你的同事穿衣服太随便，请你劝劝他。
실전2회.q_ko: 사무실에서 동료 옷차림이 너무 편함. 그를 타이르세요.
실전2회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. Two male coworkers standing in an office, one dressed in a neat suit talking to the other dressed very casually.

실전2회.q_zh: 暑假你想一个人去旅行，请你给旅行社打电话咨询一下日程安排。
실전2회.q_ko: 여름방학에 혼자 여행 가려 함. 여행사에 전화해 일정을 문의하세요.
실전2회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A woman sitting at a desk with a laptop talking on the phone, planning a trip.

실전3회.q_zh: 飞机很长时间也没有起飞，请你向空乘人员询问一下原因。
실전3회.q_ko: 비행기가 오래 이륙하지 않음. 승무원에게 이유를 물어보세요.
실전3회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A seated airplane passenger asking a flight attendant a question inside a plane cabin.

실전3회.q_zh: 你的朋友要搬家，请你向你的朋友推荐一下你住的小区。
실전3회.q_ko: 친구가 이사하려 함. 내가 사는 동네를 추천하세요.
실전3회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. Two friends talking, one with a moving box, a small thought bubble of an apartment neighborhood.

실전3회.q_zh: 公司的休息室又脏又乱，请你给公司的管理部门打电话说明一下情况。
실전3회.q_ko: 회사 휴게실이 더럽고 지저분함. 관리부에 전화해 상황을 설명하세요.
실전3회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A messy and dirty office break room with a cluttered table, trash and cups scattered around.

실전4회.q_zh: 你爱人想搬到乡下去住，可是你不想去，这时你怎么说服你爱人？
실전4회.q_ko: 배우자가 시골로 이사 가 살고 싶어하나 나는 싫음. 배우자를 설득하세요.
실전4회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A husband and wife talking to each other, a small thought bubble showing a countryside house with trees.

실전4회.q_zh: 工作的时候，你突然感到肚子疼，跟上司说明一下你的病情。
실전4회.q_ko: 근무 중 갑자기 배가 아픔. 상사에게 병세를 설명하세요.
실전4회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A woman holding her stomach in pain standing in front of her seated boss at an office desk.

실전4회.q_zh: 你的同事要请你吃晚饭，但是你有急事去不了，请你委婉地拒绝他。
실전4회.q_ko: 동료가 저녁 식사에 초대했으나 급한 일로 못 감. 완곡히 거절하세요.
실전4회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A man at an office computer desk politely declining a dinner invitation from a female coworker, a small thought bubble of food.

실전5회.q_zh: 弟弟每天骑摩托车上班，你觉得很危险，作为姐姐请你劝一下你的弟弟。
실전5회.q_ko: 남동생이 매일 오토바이로 출근해 위험함. 누나로서 타이르세요.
실전5회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. An older sister worriedly talking to her younger brother who is sitting on a motorcycle wearing a backpack.

실전5회.q_zh: 你的朋友开始学习外语了，请你向他介绍一下你学外语的经验。
실전5회.q_ko: 친구가 외국어를 배우기 시작함. 외국어 학습 경험을 소개하세요.
실전5회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. Two women sitting at a table talking, one with a thought bubble showing language study and books.

실전5회.q_zh: 你想搬家，请你拜托你的朋友帮你搬家。
실전5회.q_ko: 이사하려 함. 친구에게 이사를 도와달라 부탁하세요.
실전5회.prompt: Clean, simple flat 2D textbook illustration for a language exam, soft flat colors, thin outlines, plain white background, no text, no letters. A person asking a friend for help while packing moving boxes in a room.

실전1회.prompt: A four-panel comic strip arranged in a 2x2 grid, clean flat 2D textbook illustration style, soft flat colors, thin outlines, no text, no letters, consistent characters. Panel 1: a man buying a woman's dress at a department store counter. Panel 2: the same man arriving home where only his young daughter is present. Panel 3: the little daughter happily trying on the pretty dress. Panel 4: the man coming out and looking shocked to see his daughter wearing the dress.

실전2회.prompt: A four-panel comic strip arranged in a 2x2 grid, clean flat 2D textbook illustration style, soft flat colors, thin outlines, no text, no letters, consistent two office-worker characters (a man and a woman). Panel 1: heavy traffic jam on the road, the two arriving late and anxious. Panel 2: a very crowded elevator they cannot get into. Panel 3: the man running up the stairs while the woman waits for the elevator. Panel 4: the man already at the office desk, the woman arriving a bit later.

실전3회.prompt: A four-panel comic strip arranged in a 2x2 grid, clean flat 2D textbook illustration style, soft flat colors, thin outlines, no text, no letters, consistent character (a sleepy man). Panel 1: 7 a.m., the man sleeping in bed while his mother tries to wake him. Panel 2: an alarm clock ringing loudly on the bed, the man angrily throwing it. Panel 3: the alarm clock thrown out the window, the quiet room, the man relieved. Panel 4: a small dog bringing the ringing alarm clock back, the man forced to get up.

실전4회.prompt: A four-panel comic strip arranged in a 2x2 grid, clean flat 2D textbook illustration style, soft flat colors, thin outlines, no text, no letters, consistent characters (an older brother and a younger sister). Panel 1: the two children showing report cards to their mother after school. Panel 2: at the dinner table the brother happy and the sister sad. Panel 3: the brother watching TV lazily while the sister studies hard at a desk. Panel 4: later the sister happy with a great score and the brother sad with a lower score.

실전5회.prompt: A four-panel comic strip arranged in a 2x2 grid, clean flat 2D textbook illustration style, soft flat colors, thin outlines, no text, no letters, consistent family characters (dad, mom, and a man named Namnam). Panel 1: the family packing luggage at home for a trip. Panel 2: a dream bubble of relaxing on a beach. Panel 3: the next morning they oversleep and rush hurriedly. Panel 4: the father drives off alone in the car forgetting mom and Namnam, who look shocked.
